description: An epoll engine with an IVTS-backed, RunContinuationsAsynchronously=true async handler loop, using Tokio's readiness model: the worker thread is a pure readiness notifier (epoll -> signal) and never touches the socket; the per-connection handler resumes on the thread pool and does its own recv(). Because only the handler touches the recv buffer, there is no driver/handler race. FlushAsync does a thread-safe send() directly, so an off-worker handler responds without a handoff. Per-worker SO_REUSEPORT, pooled connections, native slab buffers, hand-rolled HTTP/1.1.
